description: This file defines a Java class 'URL' responsible for constructing and providing URLs for weather data API calls to OpenWeatherMap, utilizing location coordinates and city names.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: A class that generates URL strings for weather API requests based on location coordinates and city name.

methods.name: URL
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the weather data URL using static location coordinates and API key.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns the constructed URL for weather data based on current location.

methods.name: setCity_url
methods.description: Sets the URL for city-based weather data request, given a city name.

methods.name: getCity_url
methods.description: Returns the URL for city-based weather data request.
